method: Today: every lamp live + light-cache probes
how: Each pixel adds up the lamps near it (31 in the Loft); bounced light comes from probes about 1 m apart.
verdict: Measured: 16 from film. Only 2 of 46 lamps cast shadows on the phone; the rest light through shades, shelves, floors and the roof (strips 15x too bright). The bounce probes add almost nothing.

used_by: PC and console games (shadow maps per lamp, or ray-traced)
how: Each lamp gets its own shadow map, or a ray per pixel checks it can see the lamp.
phone_fit: Phone affords 2 shadow maps; High's rays cost too much on the phone
verdict: High (rays for every lamp) moved 16.1 to 14.4. Right idea, too costly live for 46 lamps.

used_by: Most mobile games; Unity and Unreal for still rooms
how: The slow renderer works out all the light once (bounces too) and stores it on every surface; the phone reads one picture per pixel.
verdict: Round 3 built it (render.bake): 16.1 to 10.9 from film, 1.8x to 1.2x bright, the best of every method tried. Kept in 10 cm cells per facing, found by hash, no unwrapping; 122,525 cells, 2.5 MB. Still to do: shipped baked instead of baked on the phone, lamps that change, sharper than 10 cm.

method: Light maps with light groups (a mixer)
used_by: Nobody live on a phone browser, as far as found
how: Bake each group of lamps into its own layer; the phone mixes the layers, so a lamp can dim, switch or change colour live, bounces included.
phone_fit: A few picture reads per pixel
verdict: Our candidate for 'film light, live control'.

how: Work out once which surface patches see each other; at play time light flows along those links, so lamps can move and change.
phone_fit: Ran on old consoles and phones
verdict: Moving lamps with real bounce; coarser than light maps.

how: Our light cache, closer together, each probe knowing what it can't see so light doesn't leak through walls.
Each object keeps a low-detail 'card' of its lit surface; rays through a distance field and the screen gather bounce light every frame.
phone_fit: Not on phones (Unreal's phone renderer leaves it out)
verdict: The feel the owner wants; too heavy to copy. We aim at its look by other means.

how: Probes in layers: near ones see close light sharply, far ones see far light coarsely.
phone_fit: About 5x the rays of the light cache
verdict: Tested 2026-11-10 (loop research cascades): no better than the light cache for 5x the work.

method: Many lamps by sampling (ReSTIR / lamp picking)
how: Each pixel works out a few lamps that matter and estimates the rest by sampling, reusing good picks from neighbours.
phone_fit: Fixed cost, whatever the lamp count
verdict: Fixes the cost of live lamps, not the flat look.
